system.description:
The "Silent Sniper" you have acquired is treated as having a +1 SR (maximum SR is acceptable). If you do not have it, it is treated as having SR1. A leather armor modeled after the armor of a general renowned as the best archer of the ancient kingdom. The center of gravity and joints are designed to facilitate shooting, allowing for powerful single shots.

Soul-Cutting Scissors[Core Material](60G)+Studded Leather(180G)+[Magic Catalyst 5](40G)×3+Crafting Cost(180G)
